findings.title: Pass 2 can transmit Repository knowledge without RepositoryAccessScope
evidence: WorkerAgentDispatcher.cs:59-67 exposes an unscoped compatibility overload that dispatches Pass 2.
WorkerAgentJsonContext.cs:121 serializes supplied Code Logic Document content.
WorkerAgentProductionRegistrationTests.cs:209 exercises the unscoped production path.

findings.title: The embedded prepared flow is not authoritative at runner or commit boundaries
evidence: SequentialScanRunner.cs:219-255 accepts a caller-created resolved flow and constructs Pass 2 directly.
WorkerAgentResultCommitter.cs:168-209 checks packet self-consistency but not the injected PreparedPass2Flow identity and members.

findings.title: Pass 2 lacks stable retry identity and can strand a Scan
evidence: SequentialScanRunner.cs creates Pass 2 JobId with Guid.NewGuid and persists BeginPass2 before dispatch.
Cancellation is rethrown while the durable in-flight job remains and re-entry creates a different identity.
Completed persistence lacks the Pass 1 replay barrier.

findings.title: A changed Pass 2 payload for a committed job is accepted as an idempotent replay
evidence: WorkerAgentResultCommitter.cs:491-510 compares shallow metadata and provenance targets only.
Canonical content, summary, purpose, outcome, step text, sections, anchors, and trace evidence are omitted.

findings.title: Production Pass 1 packets omit structural context, communication evidence, and permitted reference targets
evidence: SequentialScanRunner.cs:548-565 uses the compatibility packet factory.
WorkerAgentJobPacket.cs:264-269 supplies three empty collections.

findings.title: Pass 1 accepts and commits a Code Logic Document with zero Source Anchors
evidence: WorkerAgentResultEnvelope.cs checks only the upper anchor bound.
WorkerAgentResultCommitter.cs permits empty anchors and empty section SourceAnchorIds.

findings.title: Valid multiline generated Markdown is rejected
evidence: WorkerAgentResultEnvelope.cs sends section Markdown through a validator that rejects newline.
WorkerAgentJobPacket.cs has a layout validator that intentionally permits newline.
